coordinate_system: X horizontal, Y height, Z depth; origin room-floor center
method: Manual visual comparison of genuine Chromium #40729395023 V3 (700x560) against byte-original Refernzbild.png (1402x1122). Freeze camera V3, keep 11 other instance transforms unchanged. Correct the visible structural problem that source bed currently points toward the camera, whereas the reference headboard is on the right wall and bed extends toward left-center: rotate source bed Y from -90 to 180 (no source GLB mutation), scale to 0.96, ground it, keep conservative world AABB within fixed room. Reorient genuine dresser along left wall, scale to 0.90, ground and keep separated from chair. Both anchors locked provisionally; only real WebGL A/B can determine whether the silhouettes actually improve. No claim of visual acceptance.

per_object_rationale.room_bed: Current V3 screenshot shows a front-facing bed with long axis into camera, inconsistent with original reference where bed headboard sits against right wall and bed extends into center. Rotate source model to Y=180 (headboard toward right) and reduce from 1.11 to .96 so right edge still fits x=2.2m; preserve floor grounding at y≈.589m. Locked=TRUE provisionally; manual screenshot criterion remains FAIL until actual proof.
per_object_rationale.room_dresser: V3 genuine raster shows broad dresser face spanning ~29% of image and too low, original reference has left-cropped sideboard spanning ~19% and higher top. Rotate along left wall Y=0, center x=-1.95/z=.40 and scale .9 to test longer depth-wise form within AABB, distinct from bed and chair. Its front-facing material may become incorrect after yaw; real browser screenshot decides. Locked=TRUE provisionally.
per_object_rationale.room_plant_large: Rear left; original GLB bounds crossed left/back walls, moved inward by actual measured penetration and grounded.
per_object_rationale.room_plant_small: Visible front-right bedside plant; conservative GLB bottom placed near actual front nightstand tabletop height 0.40m.
per_object_rationale.room_floor_lamp: Secondary left/back zone near chair/window according to reference landmarks; grounded measured source envelope; placement is exploratory.
per_object_rationale.room_nightstand_back: Back-right of bed in source model, moved inside right/back boundaries, grounded; next to bed rather than over its conservative X envelope.
per_object_rationale.room_nightstand_front: Shift small foreground bedside cabinet to near-right room front, conservatively separated in depth from moved bed; no source changes.
per_object_rationale.room_lounge_chair: Scale chair from miniature 0.5 to visible 0.73, reposition behind near-left dresser and in front of back-left plant, keep depth separation.
per_object_rationale.room_rug: Shift rug toward open lower middle/right; real world bounds remain in fixed room and under bed where appropriate.
per_object_rationale.room_foreground_table: Move small genuine original table to near front, reduce visual overlap with bed; full-width near-camera reference table not yet reproducible, still visually rejected.
per_object_rationale.room_window_drapes: Old source GLB 3.418m tall, extended beyond 2.65m ceiling, rear wall and floor; 1.55→1.10 scale gives 3.14m width/2.43m height, placed near back wall.
per_object_rationale.room_wall_shelf_books: Move actual wall shelf right on back wall toward reference sector; wall elevation unchanged.
per_object_rationale.room_round_mirror: Advance mirror on left wall toward left-cropped reference sector; wall elevation unchanged.

phase_b_limits.known_problem: The single unchanged in-room table mesh cannot replicate the full-width near-lens reference table/laptop band with the current exact room and architecture-calibrated camera. Prefer reducing bed occlusion, not claiming table acceptance.

reference_bbox_estimates_normalized.origin: Manual approximate 700x560 visual outlines after directly opening ORIGINAL reference (1402x1122) and real Chromium V3; images contain unavoidable person/occlusion/crop. Not machine segmentation and not precise targets.
reference_bbox_estimates_normalized.caveat: Direct projected AABB is larger than the visible mesh silhouette, and person/lighting/mesh-front semantics prevent numerical alone from certifying visual fidelity.

candidate_name: V5 experimental left-wall dresser front-facing hypothesis (strict visual FAIL until tested)

v5_proposal.reason: Genuine run21 V4 yaw0 WebGL exposed visually blank/side-facing long cabinet; yaw90 alternative exposed ribbed front but rotated cabinet broadside and appeared too squat. A 180-degree pivot preserves same cabinet wall footprint/AABB and tests whether the other source-facing side displays doors toward room center. This is a hypothesis, not established improvement.
uncertainties: Reference cabinet clipped at left edge and partly obscured by vase/flowers
Original GLB has materially different finish and back/front-face uncertain until WebGL
No optical PASS based on AABB or unrendered geometry

inherited_prior_v4_review.reference_box_basis: Approximate visually observed bounding targets in existing reference_bbox_estimates_normalized; bed partially occluded by person, dresser cropped at left. NOT pixel segmentation.
inherited_prior_v4_review.metrics_method: Same frozen V3 camera, source-GLB conservative world-AABB 8-corner projection to 700x560, clipped to visible [0,1] image, 2D IoU with approximate reference bbox; this quantifies AABB alignment only, not silhouette/material equivalence.

bed.visual_reason: Actual source bed is horizontal to right wall rather than foot-on to camera. Headboard/front silhouette and fill still differ; reference woman occludes bed.

dresser.visual_reason: Selected V4 fills closer to reference left-cropped cabinet sector; however presented side/end-panel orientation lacks the reference front-door appearance. Yaw90 alternative exposes front but remains too low/wide.

inherited_prior_v4_review.rationale: The actual three WebGL frames and original reference were opened. Best measured two-anchor balance is the already saved selected-locked candidate; avoid speculative geometry change without a measured visual improvement.
inherited_prior_v4_review.next_target: Target only dresser source-facing appearance with fixed V3 camera, frozen bed and all other 11 objects; real WebGL trials required before any replacement. No Android integration.
